Beware of Misleading Communication

District Employment and Professional Guidance Centres provide free of cost to all jobs including employment registration, renewal of registration, scholarship for unemployed youth, additional registration, change of address etc.

Further, all the above services have been facilitated by the applicants through the website www.tnvelaivaaippu.gov.in

Therefore, the public should not cheat on fake advertisements or intermediaries by giving personal information or money.

  • If any such communication is received, please reach out to the helpline or control room

  • 044-29580200 | 1930 (Cyber Crime)
